zh.title: 剑桥春晚｜把多节目制作汇成文化现场
zh.summary: 以新春演出为共同目标，组织策划、舞台、节目与人物准备，让多项制作工作服务同一现场，并留下可用于活动回顾的影像。
zh.preview: 晚会的连贯体验来自节目背后的组织。我们的参与从策划与舞美搭建协调延伸至节目、人员、妆造和记录，覆盖台前呈现所依赖的多项工作。
zh.role: Vivian Adventure 参与晚会策划、舞美与搭建协调、节目衔接、人员联系、妆造及现场记录，以演出节目为工作参照。
zh.context: 2026 年剑桥春晚以新春为文化背景，将多个节目汇集成一场演出。每个节目都涉及舞台和人物准备，制作需要兼顾单项演出的要求与整场晚会的连续性。

narrativeSections.heading: 共同节日，多种舞台表达
narrativeSections.text: 新春主题为不同节目提供共同背景，而舞台呈现需要容纳各自的表达。晚会策划与制作的关联，在于把分散的节目任务组织到整场演出的框架之中。

narrativeSections.heading: 以节目为单位处理制作依赖
narrativeSections.text: 舞美搭建、人员到位与妆造准备都影响节目如何进入舞台。团队参与策划及这些执行环节，使节目衔接能够与舞台条件、人员安排共同考虑。

narrativeSections.heading: 留下可以回看的文化现场
narrativeSections.text: 主题舞台、发言和集体谢幕影像保留了晚会的不同侧面。现场记录与制作支持共同构成交付，既服务演出当下，也为活动回顾与后续文化项目介绍提供具体材料。

deliverables: 晚会策划、舞美与搭建协调
节目衔接、人员联系及妆造配合
主题舞台、发言与集体谢幕等现场影像
outcomes: 交付覆盖晚会策划制作支持及现场记录，围绕多个节目组织执行。
影像保留新春主题与集体演出场景，可用于活动回顾和文化项目介绍。

en.title: Cambridge New Year Gala | Many Acts, One Cultural Occasion
en.summary: Planning, stage coordination and performer preparation served a shared New Year programme, with event imagery giving the occasion a record for later recaps.
en.preview: A coherent gala depends on the work behind each act. Our involvement spanned planning, stage-build coordination, programme transitions, people, styling and documentation.
en.role: Vivian Adventure contributed to gala planning, stage design and build coordination, programme transitions, people liaison, styling and documentation, organising its work around the performances.
en.context: The 2026 Cambridge Chinese New Year Gala brought multiple acts together around a shared cultural occasion. Each performance had preparation needs, while the production also had to account for the continuity of the evening.

narrativeSections.heading: A shared occasion, different performances
narrativeSections.text: The New Year theme gave the programme a common setting while allowing different acts their own expression. Planning and production concerned how those individual requirements could sit within one gala.

narrativeSections.heading: Working through the needs of each act
narrativeSections.text: Stage preparation, people and styling all affect how a performance reaches the audience. Involvement across these areas allowed programme transitions to be considered alongside the stage conditions and personnel arrangements.

narrativeSections.heading: A cultural event that can be revisited
narrativeSections.text: Images of the themed stage, speaking segment and collective finale retain different aspects of the gala. Documentation sat alongside production support, leaving material for event recaps and introductions to later cultural projects.

deliverables: Gala planning, stage design and build coordination
Programme transitions, people liaison and styling support
Event imagery including the themed stage, speaking segment and finale
outcomes: The delivery combined planning and production support across the programme with event documentation.
The imagery retains the New Year setting and collective performance for recaps and cultural project introductions.
